levels_note: Pokemon levels follow the chapter: ch0 5 up to ch21 about 55.

chapters.title: The Fall of Renais
before: Grado's army has broken the peace and marched on Renais. The castle is burning.
Eirika, you must run. Find your brother Ephraim in Frelia.
after: O'Neill falls back. The road to the border is open.
scene_before: Seth: Princess Eirika, the king has fallen. Grado is inside the walls.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Father... Then we fight our way out.
scene_after: Seth: Frelia will shelter us. Ephraim is the one hope Renais has left.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: I will not let Renais fall for nothing.

chapters.title: Escape!
before: Grado soldiers hunt the royal party on the road to the border.
after: Breguet is beaten. The border at Mulan is close.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Ephraim is in Frelia. We cannot stop now.

scene_before: Seth: Grado soldiers hold the road. Stay behind me, Princess.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Frelia is just beyond the border. Keep moving.
scene_after: Seth: The Mulan border is behind us. Lyon is with Grado, Princess.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Lyon... I cannot believe he would let this happen.

chapters.title: The Protected
before: Bandits hold the border town. Ross and Garcia stand in their way.
after: Ross and Garcia fall back. The border road is open.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Stay close. The border fort is ahead.

scene_before: Ross: Eirika! Garcia and I will cover the pass.
Garcia: Hah! A few bandits. Leave them to me.
scene_after: Ross: Ow. Did we win? Dad would be proud.
Ephraim: Eirika! I came as fast as I could. Are you hurt?

chapters.title: The Bandits of Borgo
before: Borgo Ridge is full of bandits. Seth rides at your side.
after: Colm, a thief of Renais, offers his help.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: These bandits are not Grado's. They only want the pass.

scene_before: Seth: Borgo Ridge ahead. Bandits, and worse, I fear.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Stay close, Seth. We cannot be delayed.
scene_after: Colm: Easy, Princess. I only steal from people who deserve it.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then you may travel with us, Colm. Please behave.

chapters.title: Ancient Horrors
before: The dead walk in Zaha Woods. Something old has woken.
after: The graveyard falls quiet.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The dead should not walk. Something is waking them.

scene_before: Seth: The dead walk here. I have never seen the like.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Something is calling them. Hold steady.
scene_after: Seth: The graveyard is quiet again. Whatever stirred them is gone.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Magvel is not what it was. We should hurry.

chapters.label: 5x
chapters.title: Unbroken Heart
before: Eirika dreams of Renais. A shadow of the siege plays out once more.
scene_before: Zonta: Renais will fall again, Princess. Again and again.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: No. This time I stand and fight.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: I will not run from my own home again.

after: Zonta fades. The dream releases Eirika.
scene_after: Seth: Princess? You were speaking in your sleep.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Only a memory, Seth. I am ready now.

chapters.title: The Empire's Reach
before: Grado troops hold the city. A swordsman named Joshua watches from the walls.
after: Joshua joins you for a fee and a laugh.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Grado's soldiers are everywhere. Keep moving.

recruit_lines.Joshua: Joshua: Heh. A princess on the run? I will lend my sword. Fair pay, fair play.

scene_before: Seth: Grado holds the city. Be ready for anything.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Joshua. We meet again at last.
scene_after: Joshua: Tch. Grado pays badly. You pay better, Princess.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then ride with us, Joshua. We are going to Renvall.

chapters.title: Victims of War
before: A burned village. Novala's dark mages are close.
after: The villagers are safe for now.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Whole villages stand empty. I will not forget this.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_JOSHUA
ally_talk.text: Joshua: Villagers first, coin later. Even I cannot take pay from this lot.

scene_before: Novala: Burn the villages. Leave nothing for Renais.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Whole villages stand empty. Who does this?
scene_after: Seth: The last of Novala's mages have fled. The survivors are safe.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: I will remember every name on this road.

chapters.title: Waterside Renvall
before: Pirates and Grado knights fight over the Renvall docks.
after: Murray is down. The harbor is yours.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The coast road is open. Let us hurry.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_JOSHUA
ally_talk.text: Joshua: Harbor towns are easy to love. Shame about the guards.

scene_before: Murray: Renvall is ours. Take the docks and leave nothing.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: The harbor is the key to the coast. Take it back.
scene_after: Seth: The docks are clear. A ship can take us to Frelia.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then we sail. Ephraim must be told of this.

chapters.title: It's a Trap!
before: A trap at Renvall. Tirado, Caellach and Selena spring it.
after: The way splits. Eirika goes to find Frelia and Prince Innes.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: This is a trap. Watch every step.

scene_before: Tirado: A trap, Princess. The road ends here.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Seth, they knew we would come. Hold the line.
scene_after: Ephraim: Eirika, we must split here. I will march on Grado itself.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then I will go to Frelia and find Prince Innes. Be careful, brother.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_JOSHUA
ally_talk.text: Joshua: A trap, hm? I have been in worse card games. Stay sharp.

chapters.title: Distant Blade
before: Frelia's castle. Tana and Amelia wait on the wall.
after: Tana the pegasus rider joins you.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: A lone fighter holds the road ahead.

recruit_lines.Tana: Tana: Princess Eirika! I am Tana of Frelia. Innes is waiting. Let me guide you.

scene_before: Tana: Princess Eirika! Frelia's walls are in sight.
Amelia: Um, hello! I am only a recruit, but I will help!
scene_after: Tana: Prince Innes holds Port Kiris against the revolt.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then we go to him. Thank you, Tana.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_JOSHUA
ally_talk.text: Joshua: Frelia pays in real gold. I like this castle already.

chapters.title: Revolt at Carcino
before: Port Kiris is in revolt. Innes of Frelia needs help.
after: Innes and Duessel join you.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Carcino is in revolt. Hold the line.

recruit_lines.Innes: Innes: Eirika. Your fight is mine now. Frelia's bow will cover you.
recruit_lines.Duessel: Duessel: I serve no throne now, only honor. My axe is yours, Princess.

scene_before: Gerik: Mercenaries for hire. Pay well and we cover your flank.
Tethys: Hmm, a princess. How exciting.
scene_after: Innes: Eirika, the revolt is quelled. Your timing was good.
Ephraim (letter): Grado's border forts have fallen to me. I march on the capital.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_TANA
ally_talk.text: Tana: Port Kiris is in an uproar. Innes will want a report, Princess.

chapters.title: Creeping Darkness
before: The dead walk again. L'Arachel and Dozla are lost in the mist.
after: L'Arachel and Dozla join you.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The temple is quiet. Too quiet.

recruit_lines.LArachel: L'Arachel: Fear not! The great L'Arachel has arrived to rescue you!
recruit_lines.Dozla: Dozla: Dozla is strong. Dozla will fight for you. Let us go!

scene_before: L'Arachel: Fear not, for I, L'Arachel, have come!
Dozla: Dozla follows. Princess L'Arachel talks too much.
scene_after: L'Arachel: The dead will not rise again while I have my staff!
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: We should find out what is waking them.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_INNES
ally_talk.text: Innes: Dead men in the streets. Grado has stooped very low.

chapters.title: Village of Silence
before: A quiet village where nobody speaks. Myrrh waits in a house.
after: Myrrh the dragon girl joins you.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: No one answers. Something is wrong in this village.

recruit_lines.Myrrh: Myrrh: Um... I am Myrrh. I can fight. May I stay with you? I am hungry, too.

scene_before: Maelduin: Quiet, quiet. The village sleeps. Do not wake it.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Something is wrong here. Stay together.
scene_after: Fado: ...Peace, at last.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Poor man. The village can rest now.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_DOZLA
ally_talk.text: Dozla: Quiet village. Dozla does not like quiet. Dozla likes loud.

chapters.title: Hamill Canyon
before: A canyon pass guarded by wyvern riders. Cormag rides with Grado.
after: Cormag changes sides and joins you.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The canyon narrows. Stay in formation.

recruit_lines.Cormag: Cormag: Grado betrayed my honor. I will ride with you, Princess, and prove it.

scene_before: Aias: Hamill Canyon is Grado's. Turn back.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: We cannot. The only road to Jehanna runs through it.
scene_after: Amelia: I am a real knight now, Princess! Well, nearly.
Ephraim (letter): Grado's General Duessel was not at the front. Be watchful.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_DUESSEL
ally_talk.text: Duessel: Wyverns, Princess. I will hold the canyon mouth. Go on.

chapters.title: Queen of White Dunes
before: Jehanna's desert hall. The queen holds the sand.
after: Carlyle yields. The way across the desert is open.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The desert wind is cruel. Keep your strength.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_CORMAG
ally_talk.text: Cormag: Carlyle fought well. I knew him once. Let us finish this quickly.

scene_before: Caellach: Jehanna's queen has sold the desert to Grado.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then we take it back, for her people.
scene_after: Rennac: Hmm. A scavenger, perhaps. Fine, I will fight for coin.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Welcome, Rennac. The desert is open.

chapters.title: Scorched Sand
before: Valter's wyverns burn the dunes.
after: Valter retreats toward Grado.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Sand and silence. The Queen waits.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_DOZLA
ally_talk.text: Dozla: Hot sand. Heavy armor. Dozla is fine, but Dozla wants water.

scene_before: Valter: Heh heh. A lost princess in my desert.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Valter. You will answer for Renais.
scene_after: Valter: Curse you... Grado will...
Ephraim (letter): The Sacred Stone is in the Black Temple, Eirika. We must reach it first.

chapters.title: Ruled by Madness
before: A fortress ruled by a mad lord.
after: Orson's madness breaks.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: His madness is not his own.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_LARACHEL
ally_talk.text: L'Arachel: Orson has lost his mind! Do not worry, my staff will mend you.

scene_before: Orson: Frelia, Renais... all will burn. Ha ha ha!
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: This is not the Orson I knew.
scene_after: Orson: ...What have I done?
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: It was not you. Rest now.

chapters.title: River of Regrets
before: Renais again. Lyon stands in the ruins of the castle.
after: Lyon is shaken, not beaten. Syrene steps forward.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Lyon, why? We were friends.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_MYRRH
ally_talk.text: Myrrh: The river is sad. I can feel it. Lyon, please stop.

scene_before: Syrene: Princess Eirika. Renais has suffered enough.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Lyon! Why have you done this?
scene_after: Syrene: Lyon is possessed by the Demon King. Please, save him.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then we go to the temple and end this.

chapters.title: Two Faces of Evil
before: Narube River. Something bad rises from the water.
after: The gorgon sinks.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: Two faces, and neither is the boy I knew.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_INNES
ally_talk.text: Innes: That monster is no Grado soldier. Keep your bow ready, Tana.

scene_before: Innes: This river is cursed. Tana, scout ahead.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Two faces of evil. Stand together.
scene_after: Ephraim: Eirika! You made it. I am glad to see you safe.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: And you, brother. Together we finish this war.

chapters.title: Last Hope
before: Neleras Peak. Riev's priests stand in the way.
after: The summit is clear.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: We have no way back now.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_TANA
ally_talk.text: Tana: The summit is cold, but I flew higher than this once. We are nearly there.

scene_before: Ephraim: The summit is ahead. Riev's priests guard it.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Neleras is the way to the Sacred Stone. We climb.
scene_after: Ephraim: The path to the temple is open. Stay together.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Whatever waits inside, we face it together.

chapters.title: Darkling Woods
before: The woods are black. Riev and Morva wait.
after: The way to the temple is open.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The Darkling Woods swallow the light.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_DUESSEL
ally_talk.text: Duessel: Dark woods, darker purpose. Stay close, Princess. I will take the front.

scene_before: Riev: The Sacred Stone belongs to Grado. You are too late.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Lyon is not himself. He is being used.
scene_after: Ephraim: Riev and Morva fall. The way is open.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Then let us save Lyon before it is too late.

chapters.title: Sacred Stone
before: Lyon, now possessed, waits at the end of the road.
after: Lyon's body falls. The Demon King wakes.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: The Sacred Stone is close.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_MYRRH
ally_talk.text: Myrrh: Lyon is not himself. Eirika, please save him if you can.

scene_before: Lyon: Eirika... Run. Please, run.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Lyon! Fight it. I am here.
scene_after: Lyon: Thank you, Eirika. ...I am sorry for everything.
Ephraim: The Demon King wakes. Eirika, he is here!

chapters.title: Sacred Stone (Final)
before: Fomortiis rises.
after: Fomortiis is destroyed. Magvel is at peace. The end.

mid.speaker: SPECIES_EIRIKA
mid.text: This ends here.

ally_talk.speaker: SPECIES_INNES
ally_talk.text: Innes: We have come far. Finish this, Eirika. Renais will rise again.

epilogue: SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: The Sacred Stone is sealed and Magvel sleeps again. Renais will be rebuilt.
Ephraim: Renais is free, Eirika. I will help you rebuild it, stone by stone.
SPECIES_INNES
Innes: Grado is broken. I will take Frelia's banner home. I owe you a debt, Eirika.
SPECIES_TANA
Tana: Peace suits the skies over Frelia. I will fly the borders every dawn.
SPECIES_LARACHEL
L'Arachel: Of course Rausten's hero saved the day! I shall write a ballad of it.
SPECIES_DOZLA
Dozla: Hah! A good war, and a better feast. Pour me another!
SPECIES_JOSHUA
Joshua: Not bad for a gambler's luck. Now to see what the Jehanna tables hold.
SPECIES_DUESSEL
Duessel: The Silver Axe guarded a king once. Now I will guard the peace.
SPECIES_CORMAG
Cormag: Grado's wyverns will answer to no emperor again. I will see to it.
SPECIES_MYRRH
Myrrh: The dragon sleeps. I am a child again, and I am happy.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Thank you, all of you. The war is over. Let us go home.
chapters.label: 21x
scene_before: Fomortiis: Foolish children. I am the Demon King.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Ephraim, we finish this together.
scene_after: Ephraim: It is done. The Sacred Stone is sealed.
SPECIES_EIRIKA
Eirika: Magvel is at peace. Renais will rise again.
